top_signals.title: Chevron and Exxon hit all-time highs as refining profits soar in reaction to Iran and Ukraine wars
top_signals.summary: Global diesel prices surged as Ukraine and Iran struck refineries in Russia and the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Further support for Ukraine
top_signals.summary: The Chancellor has announced a new package of over £10bn in economic and military support for Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BP Profit Hits 18-Year High as Oil Refining Margins Surge
top_signals.summary: BP Plc said profit jumped to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, speeding up the energy giant’s efforts to fix its balance sheet and pay down debt.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: One Fed Policy Can’t Fix a Two-Speed Economy, Says Janasiewicz
top_signals.summary: Jack Janasiewicz, Lead Investment Strategist at Natixis, says the U.S. economy is operating with two different neutral interest rates: one for rate-sensitive sectors and another for AI investment. He explains why additional Fed hikes could hurt housing without meaningfully slowing hyperscaler spending. Janasiewicz speaks with Bloomberg's Tom Keene and Paul Sweeney. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Starbucks Could Become a Multi-Brand Company, CEO Says
top_signals.summary: Starbucks Corp. Chief Executive Officer Brian Niccol says becoming a multi-brand company is possible, but that's not the focus right now. Two weeks ago the company said it's not buying Chipotle Mexican Grill. Niccol tells Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick he'd never say never, but for now, the company is concentrating on improving stores, menus and service.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan to Overtake China As World’s Top LNG Importer This Year
top_signals.summary: Japan is expected to overtake China as the world’s largest importer of liquefied natural gas (LNG) this year, for the first time since 2022, as high LNG prices and sufficient storage in China limit purchases, analysts at ICIS and Kpler say.  Japan’s LNG demand will exceed, albeit slightly, demand in China, according to estimates by the consultancies compiled by Reuters. Imports into Japan are estimated at 62 million metric tons, while Chinese imports are expected at 61 million tons this year, according to ICIS. Kpler also sees…
